punchline: For patients medicine could not fully help, a hospital offered an eight-week course in paying attention.
thirty_sec: In 1979 Jon Kabat-Zinn founded a clinic at the University of Massachusetts Medical Center. Physicians sent patients who were not responding completely to traditional treatment. The program was eight weeks of mindfulness meditation and yoga, with daily practice. MBSR is now offered in more than 740 hospitals and clinics. The lesson in Full Catastrophe Living: attention is trained by daily routine.
